desc:
Start on a blank world and turn it into something amazing. Whether you're building massive cities, weird creations, or just messing around with friends, it's all up to you.

🧱 Access a huge variety of blocks and tools
💾 Your builds save automatically in private servers
👥 Play solo or invite friends to build together
🎨 Experiment, create, and try new ideas
😄 Mess around, troll a little, and enjoy the chaos

Every time you join, it’s a fresh canvas.

Build big. Build weird. Build Whatever.
